title: κύβοι ἐπὶ ταῖς τραπέζαις
learning_goal: Practice color adjectives with masculine nouns (κύβος) and location prepositions (ἐπί) with repeated τίθημι and βαίνω patterns.
plot: Different animals place colored cubes on tables in various locations until Lukos arrives and falls, requiring Hyperbrephos to help.
